reviews.outcome: HALBEISEN-03 records the invalid binary-mess construction in implication(c) to(d). The adopted repair proves ultrafilter-to-propositional-compactness directly on the set of all total Boolean valuations and their formula truth sets; it never chooses one realization per finite fragment. The compactness-to-Boolean-filter extension proof will spell out finite generated subalgebras and a nonzero cell below the finite filter meet. Independence/strictness and later choice hierarchy results are not adopted.
